source.name: Tele MANAS National Tele Mental Health Programme
source.publisher: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India (NIMHANS apex centre)
source.reuse_basis: Facts and link only; no reuse licence was found. The home and FAQ pages read on 2026-11-17 link only a Privacy Policy and state no copyright or reuse terms. MedAssist copies no text, images or logos: it records the service name, the toll-free numbers, who may call and the modes offered in its own words, links to the page they came from and credits Tele MANAS, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

listings.area: National phone helpline, callable from Mathura (no clinic visit)
listings.access_conditions: Open to anyone with a mental health concern, their family members, and ASHAs or community volunteers calling for someone (FAQ 5). It is not an emergency service: the FAQ says emergencies such as suicide risk need doctors at a hospital.
listings.notes: The site lists 14416 and 1-800 891 4416 as toll-free numbers. It does not state whether counselling or consultation has a fee, so MedAssist shows Fee not listed. FAQ 10 says video consultations with e-prescriptions are now offered.
